title: Bandai Releasing 'Tamagotchi Ring' for 30th Anniversary
paragraphs: The Tamagotchi, the famous digital pet toy from Japan, is turning 30 years old. To celebrate, the toy company Bandai has made a new Tamagotchi that you can wear on your finger as a ring.

The Tamagotchi first came out in 1996. It is a small egg-shaped toy with a screen, and players take care of a digital pet. The new Tamagotchi Ring is the 39th version of the main Tamagotchi series, and it is the smallest Tamagotchi ever. It is only 28 millimeters long, and it is 56% of the size of the original toy. However, it still has the same egg shape, three buttons and a full-color screen.
The pet in the ring can grow into 30 different classic Tamagotchi characters from the past 30 years, depending on how the player takes care of it. Some of these characters are secret.

The ring comes in three colors: pink and pearl white, light blue and gold, and black and silver. Its size can be changed so that it fits different fingers. It also comes with a special charging stand, which is a first for the Tamagotchi series.

The Tamagotchi Ring costs 7,700 yen, or about $48. People in Japan could order it on Bandai's website until October 6, 2026. The rings will be sent to customers in February and April 2027. Bandai has not said whether it will sell the ring in other countries.
The Tamagotchi has become popular again with young people. In 2025, a Tamagotchi shop opened in Harajuku, Tokyo.
